Let your AI agent check AI video prices before it generates.

Some links on this page are affiliate links. Affiliate disclosure.

What every AI video second costs, everywhere.

What an agent can ask

The MCP server reads these prices and the deals on this site. It does not invent a price. An agent can ask for:

  • the cheapest model for a length and resolution, such as 5 seconds at 720p
  • current deals
  • a cost estimate for a project

Connect your agent

189 prices for 9 video models on 10 platforms, from Higgsfield plans to the fal, Runway and Kling APIs. Everything is converted to dollars per second of video, and the math is shown for credit plans. Checked 2026-11-11. The table below stays for people.

published rate = the vendor states this dollars per second, or states an API credit count and a credit price (Runway credits are $0.01). from credit plan = plan price ÷ credits × credits per clip ÷ seconds, using a credit count the vendor stated exactly. It is not a list price per second. estimated from credit plan = the same credit-plan math when the vendor marks the count with "~", "roughly", or "estimated". estimated rate = an API price the vendor calls approximate. promo = a temporary discount, with the end date when the vendor gave one. discontinued = the vendor has shut the endpoint down; the last recorded rate is not a current price.
